notes.subject: חוקך
notes.rationale: Usually 'your bosom'; some read 'from within your decree/ordinance' — 'bosom' kept as the literal picture

notes.subject: ⟨u⟩
notes.rationale: כלה 'finish' has no stated object; the enemies of vv.8–10 supplied in Bambara

notes.subject: כלה
notes.rationale: KJV drops 'consume' entirely; rendered here as a supplied imperative 'ka u ban'

notes.subject: Yawe (implicite)
notes.rationale: Direct address to God continues — 'why do You…?'

translation: Mun na i b'i bolo wuli — i bolo cɛma — bɔ i dumba kɔnɔ? ⟨Ka u ban!⟩
